limits: Every assigned definition was inspected for criterion retention, evidence instructions, applicability, check names/roles/proof/operators and source-clause trace. This is a desk review of the persisted evidence contract.

Original PCI clauses, exceptions, scope and temporal conditions are preserved; this turn does not re-extract or certify the source standard, actual entity applicability or deployed control effectiveness.

Supporting technical PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN observations cannot by themselves establish complete human-required conformance. Genuine applicability uncertainty remains distinct from optional collector coverage.
Runtime validation applies only to bounded detector tests and evaluator regression fixtures; no human-required control has been assessed on a customer deployment.
